key.name: effect
key.description: Drawn by plinius-ambient over the background picture (or over the 360° photo or the video, see panorama-enabled and video-enabled), under the windows. “balls” roll and “water” runs along the glass as the phone is tilted. “panorama” is left from version 0.3, where the 360° photo was an effect: plinius-ambient turns it into panorama-enabled.

key.name: density
key.summary: How many particles the effect has

key.name: panorama-enabled
key.summary: Show the 360° photo as the background
key.description: The photo of the key panorama instead of the background picture, turning with the phone; the effect is drawn over it. Excludes video-enabled: switching one on switches the other off. Choosing a background picture in GNOME Settings switches it off.

key.name: panorama
key.description: Path of an equirectangular photo (2:1, the whole sphere), as 360° cameras save them; Muga’s “Set as Background” copies one to ~/.local/share/backgrounds/360 and sets it here.

key.name: video-enabled
key.summary: Show the video as the background
key.description: The video or animated GIF of the key video instead of the background picture, looping and muted, scaled to cover the screen; the effect is drawn over it. It plays only while it can be seen (not under an app, not with the display off or always-on). Excludes panorama-enabled: switching one on switches the other off. Choosing a background picture in GNOME Settings switches it off.

key.name: video
key.description: Absolute path of a video file (anything GStreamer plays; H.264, H.265 and VP9 are decoded in hardware with plinius-vdec) or of an animated GIF. GNOME Settings copies the ones added there to ~/.local/share/backgrounds/video and sets them here. If it cannot be played, the background picture shows.
